text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. 2114 Yonge Street Incorporated, is constructing a 10-storey residential condominium building with ground floor retail at 2112 -2114 Yonge Street. The site is located on the southwest corner of Yonge Street and Hillsdale Avenue West. Transportation Services is requesting authorization to close the south sidewalk and a 5.2-metre-wide portion of the eastbound curb lane on Hillsdale Avenue West, between Yonge Street and a point 46 metres west, for a period of 19 months (i.e., May 20, 2021 to December 31, 2022) to accommodate a construction staging area. The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the closure of the south sidewalk and a 5.2-metre-wide portion of the eastbound curb lane on Hillsdale Avenue West, between Yonge Street and a point 46 metres west, from May 20, 2021 to December 31, 2022. 2. Designated Hillsdale Avenue West, between Yonge Street and a point 60 metres west, as one-way for eastbound traffic only at all times. 3. Prohibited southbound right turns and northbound left turns at all times, at the intersection of Yonge Street and Hillsdale Avenue West/Hillsdale Avenue East. 4. Amended the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the north side of Hillsdale Avenue West, between Yonge Street and Oriole Parkway, to be in effect from a point 60 metres west of Yonge Street and Oriole Parkway. 5.
